# Ghostex 12.4.0
## 12.4.0 - 2026-11-27
**Ghostex 12.4.0 is out.** Live pages and question forms close the moment you press Send, the Live page window can stay open, the voice agent speaks the language you pick with its own turn words, Executor runs on your own Executor CLI, every text box gets Ghostex's own right-click menu, Antigravity takes Gemini's place in Accounts, and Ghostex keeps far less on your disk.
### 📄 Live pages and questions
- **Send closes a Live page or a questions form at once,** and the question leaves Needs you, the Inbox and the pink dot on every computer and phone right away, instead of waiting until the agent reads your answers. - **Answers the agent couldn't be told are kept as a failed message card** with the reason and Retry, so nothing you answered is lost. - **The Live page window has a Keep open pin,** remembered for every page, so a click elsewhere in Ghostex no longer hides it. - **Export page in the page window's ⋯ menu saves the page again.**
### 💬 Chat
- **A chat you scrolled up in stays where you are while the agent works,** and your own message still takes you to the bottom (#781). - **The chat box and every other text box open Ghostex's own right-click menu** with Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All, plus Save as Boost while words are selected in the chat box and the Reply popover.
### 🎙️ Voice agent
- **The voice agent's language is a setting,** English by default or the language of the device that starts the call, and its turn words are set per language, on the computer and the phone. English keeps "reply", "over" and "go ahead". Thanks to @cagatay-io for both the computer (#780) and the phone (ghostex-mobile #68).
### 🔌 Connectors
- **Executor now uses your own Executor CLI with one sign-in for the whole computer,** and Settings > Connectors can install it and start its sign-in for you. Every Executor call follows your Ask, Allow and Never rules, and agents get no Executor tools until you sign in. Apps you added to the old built-in Executor need to be added again in Executor: Settings lists them once by name.
### 👤 Accounts
- **Antigravity takes Gemini's place in Settings > Accounts, the sidebar meter and its popup,** with usage read from the Antigravity CLI on your computer. Native Antigravity needs agy 1.5.1 or newer.
### 🌐 Browser
- **Open Externally takes the DevTools button's place in the Browser toolbar,** and Toggle DevTools moves into its ⋯ menu.
### 🧭 Sidebar and rail
- **The rail's ⋯ menu can remove every separator at once,** and right-click menus on the rail open again on macOS (#775). - **Quieter dots:** the rail's Ask Ghostex AI button shows none, and the Autopilot supervisor's row shows only red and pink ones. - **Pinned sessions linked under their lead can be dragged into a new order** (#725).
### 📂 Files
- **Close Others in a file tab's right-click menu** closes every open file but that one (#710).
### 💾 Disk space
- **Ghostex keeps far less on your disk:** the built-in browser's cache, agent event logs, visual check screenshots and old chat copies now have limits and a daily clean-up, and visual checks no longer leave Chrome running or temp folders behind.
### 📱 On the phone
- **Dictate sends your recording while you speak,** so the words come back about a second after Stop. - **A computer's SSH key can be removed or replaced from Advanced,** saving a computer no longer rewrites its stored key, and the iPhone signs in with the saved password when the computer refuses the key. - **The project header drops its computer icons,** which move into its ⋯ menu, and Back from a section of a computer's settings returns to that computer.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Windows: Terminal-based chats no longer ask "Did your message arrive?"** when a message has dashes, arrows or curly quotes (#711), and a WSL gxserver sees the app's settings (#732). - **A plain mouse wheel scrolls the Themes and Artwork rows in Settings sideways** (#776). - **Finished OpenCode sessions with a leftover shell read idle** (#721), and cleared linked workers keep reporting to their lead (#755).
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 12.3.0
## 12.3.0 - 2026-11-26
**Ghostex 12.3.0 is out.** New coordinators greet you and set themselves up with you, Live pages can come with answers already picked, the Gemini API CLI is a one-click tool, extensions can open their views and pin them to the rail, another workspace's Spaces mix right in with yours, Grok Bot pings you only when it matters, and Native chats get their connector tools back.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **A new coordinator starts with a short welcome that offers its setup as a one-click form,** asking which agents and models it should use for large, focused and simple work. You can copy another coordinator's setup with +, and without one its threads use the coordinator's own agent at High, Medium and Low effort. - **The setup is saved and becomes your default for the next coordinator,** synced across your computers. - **"How coordinators work" waits once under Needs you after setup,** and once you mark it Seen the coordinator suggests three features for your project, each as a short Live page. Seen is remembered for every coordinator. - **The How to use pill is gone from coordinator chats,** and the bell and the Inbox now agree on how many answers a page is waiting for.
### 📄 Live pages
- **Agents can send a Live page with choices already picked,** so you only change what you disagree with. - **Menu questions can show their options as tiles or segmented buttons,** and the answers card shows what you picked.
### 🧰 Tools
- **Settings > Integrations > Tools has the Gemini API CLI,** installed only when you click Install, from Google's release checked against its published checksums, and kept up to date like the other tools. - **The (i) beside it explains what it adds** over Antigravity CLI on the Gemini plan, and walks you through setting it up with an API key.
### 🧩 Extensions
- **`ghostex extensions open <id>` opens an extension's view in the side panel,** from your terminal or an agent. An agent's open asks first with a toast, unless agents may open pages without asking. - **Extensions can open their own view** with the new views.open permission, limited so they can't open it over and over, and their toast never offers Always. - **Pin view extensions to the rail** from the rail's pin menu. A turned-off extension's pin hides.
### 🗂️ Workspaces
- **With Show Work's Spaces on, the other workspace's Spaces sit right in your Spaces row,** with no switcher or divider, in one order you can drag to arrange. Swipes and Go to Space walk the whole row.
### 💬 Chat
- **The scroll-to-bottom button floats above the Inbox,** so it no longer pushes the pills around as it comes and goes. - **The Inbox bar keeps its counts on the right** and shows just "Worked for 26s" instead of the turn's summary. - **Snoozed and Recent rows in the Inbox are the same size as Needs you rows,** with only their titles dimmed.
### 🤖 Grok Bot
- **Grok Bot pings you only for asks and blockers by default,** and notes that arrive together are sent as one message. Settings > Grok Bot > Send to Grok Bot picks Asks only, Asks and blockers, or Everything.
### 🎨 Themes
- **The Theme panel's colour picker has the opacity slider,** so you can make a colour role transparent right there, as in Settings > Themes.
### 🔒 Privacy
- **`ghostex web` has a Privacy & Analytics dialog** (the shield in the header) with the same analytics switch and "what's sent" preview as Settings > About. - **A phone you remove from paired devices stops getting notifications,** and telemetry and device access are tightened further.
### 📱 On the phone
- **Settings can hide project names in notifications.** - **The phone gets the new Inbox bar and the floating scroll-to-bottom button too.**
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Native Claude and Codex chats have their workspace's connector tools again,** coordinators and their threads included. - **Agent browser clicks are hardened further:** they stay real mouse clicks at 125% and 150% display scale, on dropdowns and on pages an agent opened in the background, and fall back to a script click whenever the press might land on something else.
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 12.2.0
## 12.2.0 - 2026-11-26
**Ghostex 12.2.0 is out.** Six more agents run Native, the chat gets a History of everything you sent, big chats stop freezing, the Inbox reply arrow can go straight to the chat box, agents' page toasts get External browser and Always, Settings gains a Browser page and clearer two-choice rows, and Clone a repo lists your own GitHub repositories.
### 🤖 Native chat
- **OpenCode, Pi, OMP, Hermes Agent, Cursor CLI and Grok Build now run Native,** next to Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, with their own approval settings under Keep default. - **A Native Claude chat that hits its weekly limit switches to another account** instead of retrying the full one for hours, and its notice names when the limit resets ([#770](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/770)). - **Native chats start reliably when the agent runs a helper that touches the terminal** (an MCP headers script, a password prompt), instead of timing out and restarting ([#767](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/767)), thanks to @banozz0. - **A chat you renamed keeps its name after switching to Terminal-based** ([#763](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/763)), and Full permissions and names survive restarts, wakes and account switches ([#750](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/750)).
### 💬 Chat
- **A History pill above the chat box shows every message you sent as cards,** with search (or type M3), All / With attachments / Text only, and pictures and files on each card. It opens at once, even on huge chats. - **Clicking a History card puts that message in the chat box,** on a new line after what you already typed. Jump to message sits between Copy and ⋯, and ⋯ names every action (Copy reference, Put back, Rewind to here, Fork from here). - **Double-click a Boost pill to expand it into its full text** for this message only; Cmd+Z turns it back into the pill, and right-click offers Expand, Edit Boost and Remove. - **Copy reference and Reference in chat work for questions, work items and Live pages,** and the agent gets the quoted item with your message. - **Queued messages show why they wait as a small chip,** and long ones fold to one line with "+N lines".
### ⚡ Speed
- **Big chats open and scroll without freezes:** Quiet View no longer rechecks every row on each update (a chat with 8,000 messages froze for seconds), and the chat engine does less work per turn, so Enter registers faster. - **Saving the window layout runs off the main thread,** and the rail, the coordinator panels and SSH tunnels use far less CPU on large installs.
### 📥 Inbox and Needs you
- **Settings > Chat > Inbox reply arrow: Open the reply form or Reply in the chat.** With Reply in the chat, the arrow on an Inbox row or Work card puts the row's pill in the chat box and focuses it, with no form ([#771](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/771)). - **Inbox rows have Seen and Not needed in their ⋯ menu, and the Inbox header's ⋯ has Clear Inbox,** each with an Undo toast. Pages you clear show as Seen in Resources. - **Sending a message with an answering pill settles that to-do,** so it leaves the Inbox. - **Needs you asks can take several answers:** tick the boxes and press Send. - **A coordinator's threads always show under it,** with no Park, Pin or Snooze, and a thread shown apart carries a mark naming its coordinator, thanks to @radiumcoders.
### 🌐 Browser
- **An agent's page toast has an External browser switch and Always.** The switch sends the page to your default browser; Always opens it and stops asking for later agent pages. - **Settings > Browser gathers every browser setting on one page,** led by "Let agents open and switch pages without asking". - **Agents can open a page in the background** (`ghostex browser open --background`) without taking over your screen.
### ⚙️ Settings
- **Thirteen on/off rows are now two-choice controls that name both behaviours,** such as Close buttons: Left / Right, Interrupt with: One Escape / Two Escapes and Browser pages: Beside the views / In their own row. - **The Autopilot supervisor can run on any agent, model and effort:** Supervisor model and "When it's at its limit" open the same model picker as a new chat ([#765](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/765)). - **Settings > Workspaces can show another workspace's Spaces in this one's sidebar** (Show Work's Spaces), and opening their sessions stays in this window.
### 🎨 Look
- **Window art can be drawn as ASCII or Dither, in theme colours or Black and white,** and a Floating sidebar layout is a new choice in Settings > Window & Layout, with frosted glass Settings over that art. Your current look stays the default ([#757](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/757)), thanks to @radiumcoders. - **The rail has a Settings gear at its bottom and Theme in ⋯,** which opens the Theme editor beside it, and its menus show with the sidebar hidden. - **A worktree session shows its branch under its title,** and a merged PR's badge opens Clean up / Keep. - **The header's git pill is narrower,** with short numbers (7.3k) and arrows for commits to push or pull.
### 📂 Projects and setup
- **Clone a repo lists your own GitHub repositories,** grouped by owner and newest first, signed in through the computer's `gh`. GitHub is the first source. - **Run in terminal appears beside a failed install, a sign-in or the Linux update command,** opening a terminal with the command typed in for you to run. - **Settings > Integrations > Repair adds `~/.local/bin` to your shell's PATH itself** when `ghostex` is installed there but not found.
### 📱 On the phone
- **The phone gets History, the new Inbox menus and multi-answer asks too.** - **The terminal's command pad stays open where it fits just above the keyboard,** thanks to @cagatay-io. - **iPhone voice calls play the agent's replies from the start again,** thanks to @cagatay-io.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Pi runs the agent starts itself no longer take over the lead's chat** ([#769](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/769)). - **An OpenCode chat's status follows only its own conversation,** so a finished chat no longer reads as working while a sibling works ([#764](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/764)). - **/compact goes through when Claude Code's command menu opens,** so Terminal-based Claude threads compact instead of showing "Message not sent" ([#768](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/768)). - **A session you put to sleep stays asleep through account recovery** ([#750](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/750)). - **Remote computers over SSH: the Browser waits until ssh is connected before it opens pages,** and computers with OpenSSH older than 8.7 connect. - **Typing a dead-key accent no longer crashes the Files view** ([#749](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/749)). - **The tool line shimmer only sweeps colour,** so the text keeps its size and weight. - **Live page and question windows glide when dragged on macOS** ([#761](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/761)), thanks to @banozz0. - **Windows: the window reopens where you closed it** ([#753](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/753)), and Live page windows resize from every edge and stay where you leave them. - **Saved Prompts, Export Transcript, Attach and Scroll to Top or Bottom hotkeys work in Native chats** ([#756](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/756)). - **A session can hold up to 100 open to-dos for you.**
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 12.1.1
## 12.1.1 - 2026-11-25
**Ghostex 12.1.1 is out.** This patch fixes saving the Auto permission mode and the approval prompts chats kept showing after switching to Native, and makes switching projects in a new session calmer.
### 🔐 Permissions
- **Auto now saves in Settings > Agents > Permission mode on the computer.** 12.1.0 added it, but picking it there failed to save. - **Chats that 12.0 set to Ask on its own follow Accept all and Full permissions again.** A one-time cleanup removes that automatic Ask from Native chats and coordinator threads, and an Ask you pick in a chat's Mode menu is kept from now on. - **A skip-permissions flag in the agent's command counts as Full permissions in Native chats,** as it already did in Terminal-based chats (`--dangerously-skip-permissions` for Claude Code, `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` or `--yolo` for Codex). A level picked in the Mode menu or a Permission mode set for the chat or agent still comes first.
### ✨ New sessions
- **No project and the project you pick stay put until you press Send,** on the computer and the phone, instead of moving the draft while you choose. - **On Send, the chat moves into its project quickly and smoothly,** and the sidebar stays on the Space you were in.
### 🔒 Privacy and analytics
- **Settings > About has a Privacy & Analytics section with a switch for anonymous usage analytics,** also on the second onboarding step and in the phone's Settings. Turned off, Ghostex stops all usage tracking and sends only one anonymous weekly count of active installs, and only in weeks you use it. Starting Ghostex with `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` or `--no-analytics` stops even that. - **View what's sent in Settings > About shows the analytics Ghostex sends,** and your choice survives "Reset all settings to defaults".
### 📥 Inbox and Needs you
- **Inbox rows whose item has any detail get the Details button,** on the computer and the phone, so a short detail is no longer hidden. - **A coordinator's Needs you item carries everything you need to act on in Details,** such as text to paste, a command or a link, and a to-do that asks you to paste, run or open something without including it is refused.
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 12.1.0
## 12.1.0 - 2026-11-25
**Ghostex 12.1.0 is out.** New sessions start in one click with No project and Coordinator pills, Settings > Agents gains an Auto permission mode, Rewind works in Native chats, Needs you cards get Details and Run it, and chats keep their permission mode when they switch to Native.
### ✨ New sessions
- **New session is one click.** The sidebar's New session row and Cmd+N open a chat draft right away in the active project (or Main Hub), and a draft you never typed in goes away when you leave it. - **No project and Coordinator pills sit above a new draft's chat box,** so you can start a chat without a project or make it a coordinator before you send. The setup bar's shortcut hints show when you hover. - **The New Thread picker is gone,** and a project header's terminal and agent buttons now live in one split menu on its chat button.
### 🔐 Permissions
- **Settings > Agents has an Auto permission mode for Claude Code and Codex,** for Native and Terminal-based chats. - **"Skip permissions", "Bypass permissions", "Full access" and "Always approve" are now all called Full permissions,** on the computer and the phone. - **Switching a Terminal-based chat to Native keeps its permission mode,** so a Claude chat in Auto, Accept edits or Bypass no longer restarts asking before every edit and command ([#746](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/746)). - **Keep default follows Claude's and Codex's own settings in Native chats** instead of always starting at Ask ([#742](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/742)). - **Accept all turned on for a computer without the app (`ghostex settings set`) now applies everywhere,** coordinator threads included ([#744](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/744)).
### 💬 Chat
- **Rewind works in Native Claude Code and Codex chats.** Files stay as they are, as in Terminal-based chats, and a rewind holds even when the chat sleeps or restarts before your next message. - **The agent's thoughts show in the Working line as single-line cards** with a preview that fades out. - **"Agent was interrupted" is a divider with a stop sign,** on the computer and the phone. - **A new chat's empty screen is calmer:** the agent, the headline and the tips card, without starter buttons. Onboarding's last step drops its starter prompts too, and the wrong "Queue your next prompts" tip is gone. - **The Suggested Boosts row above the chat box is removed.** - **Expanding a Quiet View line opens its last group.** - **Native Claude chats offer only the / commands Claude answers there.**
### 📥 Inbox and Needs you
- **Needs you cards have a Details button and keep their answers when folded,** and opening one from a notification shows it. - **A Needs you card can carry a command with a Run it button** that runs it on the right computer, on the computer and the phone. - **Inbox rows above the chat box show one line,** the title. - **Opening an automation run's session marks it read,** so the "N unread" badge clears ([#719](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/719)).
### 🧭 Main Hub and coordinators
- **Main Hub folds each computer's rows, and Sessions is now Chats** with a New chat row. - **Coordinators can set the model and effort of an OpenCode thread** (`start-thread --model --effort`) without changing OpenCode's saved default ([#747](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/747)). - **A thread whose report already reached its coordinator no longer sends a false "its final message could not be read"** ([#748](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/748)). - **A session whose subagents are still writing is no longer flagged "Not moving"** ([#741](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/741)), thanks to @cagatay-io. - **A session waiting on an approval keeps reading as needing you** when its screen readings finish out of order or are dropped by a restart or sign-in ([#740](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/740), [#743](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/pull/743)), thanks to @cagatay-io.
### 🌐 Remote computers
- **Update gxserver really updates WSL and Linux remotes:** it installs the new package and restarts it, and says so when that computer runs the Ghostex app instead ([#745](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/745)). - **Phone commands work on computers whose login shell is fish,** thanks to @escottalexander.
### 📂 Files
- **Files has Back and Forward** (Cmd+[ and Cmd+]) that return to each file at its scroll position ([#733](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/733)).
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Antigravity updates from Settings > Updates with `agy update`,** and Update all skips update methods that have no command instead of doing nothing ([#739](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/739)). - **Usage analytics are more private:** a random install ID only, nothing sent before you finish onboarding, daily summaries only on days you use Ghostex, and custom agent names are never sent. - **Ghostex Help runs setup commands itself** instead of asking you to copy and paste them. - **Buttons and the Boost pill use calm neutral fills,** and suggested-link pills no longer show on coordinators. - **The pill showing who answered a shared Live page lines up with the window's controls.**
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).

# Ghostex 12.0.0
## 12.0.0 - 2026-11-24
**Ghostex 12.0 is the Native Chat update.** Chats with Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity now run Native: steadier, smoother streaming, faster, and they recover on their own. New chat users start on Native, more agents are moving to Native, and Terminal-based mode is now legacy.
### 💬 Native chat - **Native is the new way to chat with Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.** Ghostex talks to the agent directly instead of reading a terminal, so replies stream smoothly, nothing gets lost in screen scraping, and chats use less CPU. - **Messages you send while the agent is working go in right away.** The agent keeps going with its current reply, approvals stay open, and your messages are answered in order. A message you queue on purpose says "Delivers when the current reply ends." - **Native chats heal themselves.** If an agent's host stops mid-reply, Ghostex notices within seconds, clears "working" and picks the same chat back up, and the old agent is always stopped first so only one agent ever writes to a chat. - **Messaging a sleeping or finished thread wakes it** and delivers the message, with no reload. - **An expired Claude sign-in retries once with your refreshed login,** then shows a Sign in again / Switch account card instead of a raw error. - **Codex in Native:** /compact works, model picks it doesn't support are refused, errors show as cards, account switches work, and the / list only offers commands that work. - **Antigravity in Native** keeps pictures on your messages, shows its own / commands and gets the blue finished dot when a reply ends. Stopping it shows "Agent was interrupted" and leaves the chat ready, like Claude and Codex. - **Claude's /context, /model and /effort output shows in the chat again,** in Native and Terminal-based chats. - **Switch any chat to Native** from the pill above the chat box, or switch all your chats at once from the Native announcement. Coordinators switch between turns, and Switch to Terminal-based lives in More actions. - **New chat users start on Native.** Terminal-based mode is marked legacy with a small dot in Settings > Agents, and it will go away in a future release.
### 🤖 Models - **The model picker always names the real model,** like Opus 5.5, GPT 6.2 Sol or Gemini 4 Neon, never "Default". With no pick, a chat starts on the newest Opus, Sol or Neon, and the model you pick becomes the default for new chats. - **Effort shows as dimmed text next to the model name,** the same in Native and Terminal-based chats. - **Settings > Agents has a Default model for each agent,** and switching between Native and Terminal-based keeps the model, effort and 1M context.
### 🔗 Share links - **Share a Live page or a localhost port with anyone through a link.** Turn it on in Settings > Sharing. Links expire after 24 hours by default, can have a passcode, and only reach that one page or port. - **People you share a Live page with can answer it.** They type their name once, their answers come back to your chat as "Answered by" them, and you can open each person's answers on the page.
### 📥 Inbox and notifications - **The Inbox is redesigned** with Pings, a Snoozed drawer and one Recent drawer for everything handled or done, with clearer icons. - **Live pages without questions get Done, or Send to agent once you type a comment.** - **The bell clears its number when you open it,** and rows stay highlighted until you close the popup or mark them read. - **Errors show above the Inbox,** and the Boosts tip sits inside the chat box.
### 🎨 Look and feel - **Modals are frosted glass that match your theme,** in every built-in theme, with calm neutral buttons instead of accent colors. - **The default theme's blue is lighter,** and the "Ask me anything" card on Main Hub matches the cards around it. - **Live page cards in chat are crisp and see-through,** and fold into compact rows in Summary mode. - **Status dots overlap when there are several,** and sit at the right of section headers. - **"Edited N files" in a chat looks like the rows around it,** with a diff for each file. - **The chat box hint is one line,** and counts read correctly everywhere ("2 need you", "Every minute").
### 🧭 Main Hub and coordinators - **Main Hub is always on.** You can collapse it, and Autopilot's supervisor now lives inside it instead of showing as separate projects. - **Session details load section by section,** so the Overview opens right away. - **Clicking a ping opens it at its final size,** and wait reasons name what a thread waits on in plain words.
### 🧩 Extensions and accounts - **VS Code, Beads and Automate are now opt-in,** and Boosts and Find are easier to discover. - **CLIProxyAPI hubs have an Add account button** for Claude and Codex that works for hubs on other computers too, plus an Accounts card and setup guide. - **Workspaces can carry their own agent instructions and Claude connectors.**
### 🪟 Windows, Linux and macOS - **Windows: six PowerShell and launch problems are fixed,** and Entra ID accounts pair with the phone. - **Windows: Claude Code and Codex installed with npm start again with PowerShell 7** in threads, Ghostex Help and restored sessions, in Native and Terminal-based chats, instead of failing with "Invalid JSON provided to --settings". - **Windows: the extra thin line between the sidebar and the chat is gone** at scaled displays like 175%. - **Linux uses the system font for chat text,** which fixes Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters, thanks to @bet4it. - **macOS: removing the menu bar icon sticks** across launches and updates. - **macOS: Finder's Open With lists Ghostex once,** instead of once for every version you've installed. - **Linux: dragging a window by its top band works on Hyprland,** and chats no longer flicker on NVIDIA under XWayland.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **Antigravity's sign-in menu shows the Finish signing in card,** and text that only looks like a login menu is no longer mistaken for one, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **An approval on a session's screen reads as needing you,** and closing one approval card no longer hides the next, thanks to @cagatay-io. - **The phone's terminal keyboard help matches how it works now,** thanks to @cagatay-io. - **Interrupted turns are never marked as finished,** and finished or closed threads no longer put a red dot on their coordinator. - **Typing /compact no longer leaves a Saved draft on your other devices.** - **Background CPU and memory use is lower** while Ghostex watches your chats. - **The phone app no longer crashes on an info hint,** and phone screen tracking is fixed.
If anything goes wrong after updating, you can go back to the version you have now in Settings › Updates, or download any older version from [GitHub](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/releases).
